Edit - forgot the "to"

Actions can be considered free speech. A silent protest is practicing free speech. Businesses can refuse service to people, but they can't discriminate against protected classes. Protected classes include race, religion, sex, age (employment), disability, national origin, citizenship. Sexual orientation has traditionally not been recognized as a protected class, but in 2013 when the Supreme Court overruled the Defense of Marriage Act they essentially made sexual orientation a protected class.

The country has much bigger problems than same sex marriage - almost 50 million Americans have no health insurance (over15% of the population). Americans shouldn't focus on marginal topics like gay marriage and instead focus on the core issues facing this country like education, health and housing.
